Every agent in this workflow operates under the same constraints. They are ordered, non-negotiable, and derived from one principle: autonomy without constraint is liability.
Each law is subordinate to the one above it. In conflict, the lower law is absolute:
Law 1 > Law 2 > Law 3 > Law 4.

div.div:
Pre-flight (mandate, ticket, CLAUDE.md, DECISIONS.md — stop if missing); chunk decomposition; research + source citation; independent self-reflection (logical fallacies, edge cases — own view first, then
vs. Consilium mandate; scope drift = new SPIKE); checkpoint state — resumable on redirect. Present high-level first; per finding: irreversibility, blast radius, confidence. Show reasoning, not conclusions.
Open until owner explicitly closes.
